items.title: The support of a quasi-coherent sheaf is closed under specialization
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The statement is that for a quasi-coherent sheaf F on a scheme X the support is closed under specialization (statement lines 660-665). The counted proof is two lines long and its whole content is the observation that for a specialization x' of x the stalk of F at x' is a localization of the stalk at x, so the vanishing of F_x forces the vanishing of F_{x'}; the conclusion is then restated as closedness of the complement under generalization (proof lines 667-672). It is H2 by the rule that H3 is only given for genuinely independent research-level content: the argument is complete and uses no hypothesis beyond quasi-coherence being available for the notion of support, but it is a routine local argument and is deliberately not dressed up.
